summary: No Stopping kerb on busy Moggill Road; no cars park here.

drivers.seclusion: Open to traffic; apartments 16-17 m from the kerb at 50-65 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a live lane edge; no pull-off. The verge and car park lie across the road.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial, four lanes, rail alongside.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on the kerb; signed No Stopping Any Time.

sun_shade: Open; trees shade the east end in the morning.
